emulator.tool: adapted ot_emu (scripts/octatrack-emulator/build.py) on the flashed beta base cd39c494, packages installed over emulated USB
emulator.fixture: otbench template project, T1 FM SYNTH (INDX 0, sine), trigs 1/5/9/13 at 120 BPM, LFO1 square from the project file; T1 stem 44.1 kHz

cases.case: LFO1 square -> AMP REL (30), DEP 60, HOLD 8, SPD 8
cases.v0.1.3: release x0.895 per 50 ms, tau ~0.45 s (REL 90 law 0.44 s)

cases.case: LFO1 square -> AMP REL (30), DEP 60, HOLD 8, SPD 48
Part VOIC 3, CHRD 4, no scene locks
cases.v0.1.3_vs_v0.1.2: bit-identical T1 stem (after a one-sample capture offset)

cases.case: Mono, PTCH LFO, no scene locks

emulator.unchanged: sample jumps at each trig on held notes are identical in 0.1.2 and 0.1.3 (the existing retrigger dip)

hardware.unit: Octatrack MKII, OS 1.40C, flashed beta base cd39c494, over USB

results: LFOs on ATK, HOLD, REL and PTCH behave as on FLEX
no clicks, stuck notes or hangs
FM matches a FLEX track for CHROMATIC keys under a PTCH scene lock, CHROMATIC keys stopped with a PTCH LFO, and the PTCH knob on a sounding locked note
a power-cycle restore of the set with this build and an FM track plays
scene locks and p-locks on VOIC/CHRD work
VOIC and CHRD switch once at the crossfader midpoint
a scene without the lock plays the knob value
RATO switches once at the midpoint on a held note
an LFO on RATO still steps around a scene-locked RATO
VOIC/CHRD jumps and AMP LFOs unchanged

unmeasured: MIDI note input with these changes
